name: Direct Chat Inquiry by XD
author: Muhammad Ali Khizar

sections.description:
WA Inquiry for WooCommerce by XD adds a professional WhatsApp inquiry button to your WooCommerce product pages, allowing customers to quickly contact you about products. The plugin is fully customizable and works seamlessly with all WooCommerce themes.

Key Features:
– Add WhatsApp inquiry button to product pages
– Multiple button position options
– Customizable button text
– Shortcode support for placing button anywhere
– Mobile-friendly design
– WhatsApp number validation
– Compatible with WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)

Developer Notes

The plugin follows WordPress coding standards and includes hooks for customization:

Filters:
– wc_wa_inquiry_button_html – Filter the button HTML output
– wc_wa_inquiry_whatsapp_url – Filter the generated WhatsApp URL

Actions:
– wc_wa_inquiry_before_button – Action before button renders
– wc_wa_inquiry_after_button – Action after button renders

To contribute, please visit our GitHub repository.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/wa-inquiry-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Configure your WhatsApp number and button settings under: WooCommerce > Settings > WA Inquiry by XD
  4. The button will automatically appear on product pages based on your settings
sections.faq:
What WhatsApp number format should I use?

Enter your full WhatsApp number with country code but without any special characters. Example: 923001234567 (for Pakistan)

Can I change the button position?

Yes, you can choose from three positions: Before Add to Cart, After Add to Cart, or After Product Summary.

Can I use shortcodes to place the button?

Yes! Use [wa_inquiry_by_xd] in any post/page/widget. Options:
– [wa_inquiry_by_xd text=”Custom Text”]
– [wa_inquiry_by_xd size=”small”]

Does this work with WhatsApp Business?

Yes, the plugin works with both regular WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business numbers.

Is this plugin translation ready?

Yes, the plugin includes .pot file for translations in the languages folder.
